sections.title: Cartoon time — You can do it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Last week, Bobby and Sam saw a new poster at school.
lines.chinese: 上周，Bobby 和 Sam 在学校看到了一张新海报。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: Bobby, why don't you take part?

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Er, I'm not good at singing.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: But you like singing! Have a go!
lines.chinese: 但是你喜欢唱歌呀！试一试吧！

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby practised singing in the morning.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: La la la ...

lines.speaker: Rooster
lines.english: Bobby is singing again!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby practised singing in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: La la la ...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby practised singing in the evening.

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: La la la ...

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Bobby is singing again!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was Bobby's turn. First he was afraid, but then he calmed down.
lines.chinese: 轮到 Bobby 了。起初他很害怕，但后来他平静了下来。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby began to sing. First he forgot the words, but then he remembered them.
lines.chinese: Bobby 开始唱歌。起初他忘了歌词，但后来他想起来了。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Bobby finished the song.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.english: You were great, Bobby!

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Thanks. I really enjoyed it. I want to sing again next year!
lines.chinese: 谢谢。我真的很享受这次演唱。我想明年再唱一次！

lines.speaker: Bobby's father
lines.english: Great! Keep trying!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Two weeks ago, Su Hai wanted to play Mulan in a school play.
lines.chinese: 两周前，苏海想在一场校园话剧中扮演花木兰。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was her first school play.
lines.chinese: 这是她第一次参加校园话剧演出。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She wanted to try her best.
lines.chinese: 她想尽自己最大的努力。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There were a lot of words in the play.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She asked Su Yang to practise with her.
lines.chinese: 她请苏洋和她一起练习。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There were also a lot of movements.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She used her dancing skills to do them well.
lines.chinese: 她运用自己的舞蹈技巧，把这些动作做好。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai was afraid of acting in front of many people.
lines.chinese: 苏海害怕在许多人面前表演。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She asked her family to watch her practise.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai practised a lot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She remembered all the words and movements.
lines.chinese: 她记住了所有台词和动作。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: She was ready.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Finally, it was time for the play.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Su Hai acted well. It was great!
